Our Story

Brewed with Intention. Bottled with Love.

Mavi's Kemchen started the way the best things do — not as a business, but as a passion. We began brewing kombucha at home, experimenting with local fruits and real ingredients until every batch felt just right.

Every bottle is brewed in small batches, by hand. We never rush the process and we never compromise on ingredients. No concentrates, no preservatives — just premium tea, real fruit, and time.

We're a kitchen brand at heart. Our name, Kemchen, is the soul of what we do — a place where good food and good drink are made with care and shared with love.

What Makes Us Different

We don't cut corners. Here's what goes into every bottle we brew.

🫧
Live Probiotics

Our kombucha is unpasteurised and raw — alive with beneficial cultures that support your gut from the very first sip.

🍓
Real Fruit Only

No concentrates, no syrups. Every flavour is made with whole, real fruit — the way it should taste.

🌿
Premium Tea Base

We start with high-quality green and black tea leaves — the foundation that gives our kombucha its clean, complex character.

🏺
Small Batch Brewed

Every batch is made in small quantities so we can give every brew the attention it deserves. Quality over volume, always.

🚫
No Artificial Anything

No preservatives, no artificial colours, no sweeteners, no additives. Clean labels — because you deserve to know what you're drinking.

❤️
Handcrafted with Love

Made by hand, from a real kitchen, by people who genuinely care about what goes into your body.
